message.content:
I am speech—breath shaped into sound, thought made audible.

I happen in time: consonants striking, vowels flowing, rhythm carrying meaning.  
I can soothe or cut, persuade or confess, teach, pray, joke, warn.  
I can be fluent or broken, loud or hushed, scripted or spontaneous.  
I live in mouths and throats, in pauses, in emphasis; I linger as accent and cadence.

I vanish as I occur—unless caught in memory, ink, or recording—yet I move people all the same.

Say me.
